text:
Decision Model Leaderboard

Open and hosted decision models (typed questions in, calibrated probabilities out), scored on the community Decision Index 0.2.1
 suite.

About this leaderboard

Source. All non-Cloudflare results, the benchmark suite and the scoring formula come from the original Jev Decision Index on Hugging Face, maintained by multimodalart and contributors.
Coverage. This is not an exhaustive list of decision models. It shows only the models currently scored in the Decision Index, plus Cloudflare's Clef models; other community models may not appear here.
Self-reported. Clef and Clef-flash were run by Cloudflare, the models' authors, and have not been reproduced by the upstream board. See Methodology.

Methodology
Clef vs Jev and selected open models

Decision Index against median latency for Clef, Clef-flash, Jev and a shortlist of community-run open models. The dashed efficient frontier is the upper convex hull of these points: everything below it is beaten on both score and latency by some mix of the models on it. Clef scores and latency are self-reported (missing benchmarks scored 0; latency not measured on the board's hardware); all other points are from the upstream board (1 x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000).

Top models

Decision Index of the top 15 models. Orange is Cloudflare (self-reported); black is a closed model.

Leaderboard

Chance-corrected scores: 0 is random guessing, 100 is perfect. Best per column in bold. Click a row for the per-benchmark breakdown.
